summary: Lewis Sydney Stewart O'Malley (1874–1941) was a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology. He earned his B.A. from Hertford College, Oxford (~1893–1897), and served as Magistrate and Collector in the Indian Civil Service from 1898 to 1924.

id: P:Lha Zang Lama Rigdzin Gar Gyi Wangchuk
summary: Lha Zang Lama Rigdzin Gar Gyi Wangchuk studied under Patrul Rinpoche, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye, and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso.

Lhagpa Phuntshogs (b. 1942) works in Tibetology. He served as president of the Tibet Academy of Social Sciences (1983–1991), secretary-general of the Research Association for the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau (1991–2000), and Director General of the China Tibetology Research Center (2000).

Lhakpa Tsering works in Tibetology and linguistics. He served as Professor at Tibet University and was attested in 2026 as Assistant Professor of Tibetan Language and Literature at the Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies.

Li-Juan Su works in Buddhist studies. She earned a Master's degree from National Taiwan Normal University and has been a PhD student at National Chengchi University, where she held a PhD student post in 2024.

Li-ching Chang (1936–2010) was a scholar of Sinology and linguistics. She taught Mandarin Chinese at the University of Washington, Tunghai University, Bryn Mawr College, Harvard University, Swarthmore College, and the University of Pennsylvania (~1980–2005).
Liang Cai works in Sinology, history, and archaeology. She studied under Daniel Boucher and was attested in 2014 as a junior scholar at the University of Arkansas.
Libbie Mills is an Indologist who completed her D.Phil. at the University of Oxford in 2011 under Alexis Sanderson. She was attested in 2020 teaching Sanskrit and Pali at the University of Toronto.

Lidia Wojtczak works in Indology and linguistics. She served as Lecturer in Sanskrit at SOAS University of London (2015–2024) and became Associate Instructional Professor in Sanskrit at the University of Chicago in 2024.
Lifei Pan specializes in Buddhist studies and Sinology. Pan studied at Ghent University and Sichuan University, where they held a postdoctoral position in 2021.
Lili Zheng specializes in Buddhist studies. She studied under MA supervisor Yongdong Shi at Fo Guang University, earning a Master of Arts attested in 2011.

Lilian Silburn (1908–1993) worked in Indology, philosophy, and religious studies. She studied under Paul Masson-Oursel, Louis Renou, and Swami Lakshman Joo, and held posts at the CNRS (~1946–1978; Boursière 1950–1970).

Lilias Homburger (1880–1969) worked in linguistics and Indology. She studied under Antoine Meillet (~1910–1914) and held posts at the École Pratique des Hautes Études (directeur d’études ~1922–1939) and the Institut national des langues et civilisations orientales.

Lilla Russell-Smith works in Buddhist studies, history, archaeology, and Iranian and Central Asian studies. She studied under Anna Eörsi and Pál Miklós, and completed a PhD at SOAS University of London.

Lily de Silva worked in Indology and Buddhist studies. She studied under Julius Berugoda and M. Sri Rammandala, and held posts at the University of Ceylon (attested 1970) and the University of Peradeniya (attested 2008).

Limei Chi works in Buddhist studies and Sinology, having studied under Jinhua Chen. Chi held posts attested in 2026 as faculty at the International College for Postgraduate Buddhist Studies and Professor at the International Institute for Buddhist Studies.
Lin He (1902–1992) was a philosopher. He studied at Tsinghua University (National Tsing Hua University) from ~1919 to 1926, and later held a post at National Tsing Hua University from ~1931 to 1952.
Lin Heng specializes in Indology and Buddhist studies. Heng earned an MA at Silpakorn University, attested in 2015, under the supervision of Chainarong Klinnoi.
Lin Li works in the fields of computational linguistics and linguistics, and has held posts at Utrecht University and Qinghai Normal University.
Lina Wang works in Sinology and Buddhist studies. She studied at Peking University and held a post at the National Library of China.
